place_fields.summary: Garden-tomb complex associated with the Barid Shahi dynasty, with landscaped grounds and Indo-Islamic monuments.

planning_attributes.description: The complex is in Aliyabad/HussaniPura Colony near Bidar Main Bus Stand; the garden setting contains Barid Shahi tombs.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: Located along Palm Road in Aliyabad/HussaniPura Colony near Bidar Main Bus Stand.
planning_attributes.notes: The Barid Shahi tombs are protected heritage monuments in a landscaped garden complex.

place_fields.summary: A major gateway of Bidar Fort, noted for its defensive role and decorative architectural features.

planning_attributes.description: Sharza Darwaza is a major entrance gate associated with the Bidar Fort complex.
planning_attributes.legend_or_history: The gateway formed part of the fortification's defensive entrance system.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: Located on Fort Road in the Old City Fort Area of Bidar as part of the Bidar Fort gateway complex.
planning_attributes.access_restrictions: Incredible India lists opening hours of 09:00-18:00; check locally for current access conditions.
planning_attributes.notes: The gate is documented by Bidar district authorities as one of the major entrances of the fort complex.
